question: Can I work while studying on a student visa?
answer: Yes, student visa holders can work up to 48 hours a fortnight while their course is in session, unless they are studying a master's degree by research or doctoral degree, in which case they and their family members can work unlimited hours (Source: [500_when_have.pdf, p.3]). However, it's worth noting that there is a general rule for everyone, and that is that student visa holders can only work up to 48 hours a fortnight while their course is in session, and unlimited hours when the course is not in session (Source: [500_when_have.pdf, p.3]).
